user.title: Connect an Aduro stove
user.description: Enter the local connection details printed on the stove. Home Assistant validates them directly with the stove before saving.

data_description.host: Local IP address of the stove, for example 192.168.1.250
data_description.serial: Up to 6 digits; shorter serial numbers are padded exactly as in the Aduro app
data_description.pin: Up to 10 digits from the stove label

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Aduro
reconfigure.description: Change the local connection details. They are tested before the integration is reloaded.

data_description.host: Local IP address of the stove
data_description.pin: Up to 10 digits from the stove label
